Application Deadlines
Prospective applicants are encouraged to explore our fields of study to confirm deadline information and specific requirements by academic department or program.
The application for Fall 2027 is now open. Use the link below to start an application:
START YOUR FALL 2027 APPLICATION
Deadlines
Your application and all required supporting materials must be submitted by the deadline listed below for the program to which you are applying. Earlier applications are encouraged; late applications are not accepted. All applications must be submitted by 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on the posted deadline date.
While the application is for Fall 2027 enrollment, all associated deadlines fall within the 2026 calendar year (e.g., November 15, 2026) and are subject to change until September 1.
Please note, the following degree programs are not accepting applications for Fall 2027: Population Studies, Computer Science, M.S.E.
